title: athyrium bellum
intro: Athyrium bellum, commonly known as Lady Fern, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the fern family (Athyriaceae). The health benefits of Lady Fern include its potential in reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions, and its ability to stimulate the production of digestive enzymes. The bioactive constituents of Lady Fern include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
